<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant M peak at ~199 and an M+2 peak at ~201 with almost equal intensity (~98% of M). This pattern is characteristic of bromine, which has two isotopes (79Br and 81Br) in roughly 1:1 natural abundance, giving an M+2 peak nearly as intense as the M peak. No other element shows such a distinctive pattern here, so bromine is the only element we can definitively identify.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
